# Bundle Library for ComfyUI

> A ComfyUI node pack that keeps named bundles of prompts, numbers, switches, images, videos and audio in a library on
> the ComfyUI server, and loads one into a workflow with a single Load Bundle node whose outputs follow the chosen
> bundle. Everything it does goes through an HTTP API that scripts and AI agents can use.

Key facts for using it from code:

- The API is served at `/api/bundle-library/v1` on the ComfyUI server (default `http://127.0.0.1:8188`). Every write
  (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`) needs the header `X-Bundle-Library: 1`; JSON bodies need
  `Content-Type: application/json`.
- Upload a file first (`POST /assets`, multipart, the `kind` field before the `file` field), then put its `sha256` in
  an image, video or audio field.
- `PUT /bundles/{id}` replaces the whole bundle: read it (`GET /bundles/{id}`), change it, and send it back with
  `expected_revision` set to the revision you read. A stale revision gets 409 `revision_conflict`.
- Errors are `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`; act on `code`.
- In an API-format prompt, the Load Bundle node is `class_type` `BundleLibraryLoad` with the inputs `bundle_id` and
  `slot_spec` (`{"v": 1, "slots": [{"name", "type"}, ...]}`, the bundle's fields that are on, in order); output `n`
  carries slot `n`, counting from 0.

## Docs

- [Automating with the API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/romanyogurt/ComfyUI-Bundle-Library/main/wiki/Automating-with-the-API.md): worked examples with curl and Python
- [HTTP API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/romanyogurt/ComfyUI-Bundle-Library/main/wiki/HTTP-API.md): every endpoint, request, answer and error
- [File formats](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/romanyogurt/ComfyUI-Bundle-Library/main/wiki/File-formats.md): the library folder, bundle files, the export ZIP, the node in a workflow
- [Compatibility and versions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/romanyogurt/ComfyUI-Bundle-Library/main/wiki/Compatibility-and-versions.md): supported ComfyUI versions and how files of other versions are treated
